evidence.quote: Duration of the program: This is a 3.5-year program consisting of 7 academic semesters
All courses are taught in English; therefore, a B2 level English proficiency is required.
The tuition fee for this program is 7,000 USD/Year
The following documents need to be submitted during the application procedure by all applicants through our online application platform - that you can reach here:

value.quotedAs: Certificate or proof of citizenship and/or permanent residence (e.g. passport)

name.fr: Reçu de paiement des frais de dossier
name.en: Bank receipt for the application fee

value.quotedAs: Bank receipt about the transfer of the application fee of 150 USD

evidence.quote: Valid, filled-in application form (to be filled online here);
a TOEFL test with a minimum score of 513 (Paper-Based).
an IELTS test with a minimum score of 5.5.
The language proficiency of applicants must be proven with a standardized, at least intermediate (B2) level language certificate, obtained at a proctored exam.
Admission requires a high school certificate and passing entrance exams in Mathematics and Physics.

note.fr: Contrôle manuel : Les candidats doivent passer des examens d'entrée en mathématiques et en physique ; pour plus d'informations, consultez le site web de l'université.
note.en: Manual check: Applicants must pass entrance exams in Mathematics and Physics; for further information, see the university website.

evidence.quote: Yes, admission is based on a high school certificate and online entrance exams in mathematics and Physics.

notes: Tuition and fees are quoted in USD, which is outside the standard currency list; the pages state "7,000 USD/Year" directly, so no conversion was made. The generic deadline "for September 2027 intake (all programs): 15th May 2027" was used as no programme-specific date with a year is given (the programme page states "The application deadline is 15th June." without year).
